capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia: 24.2 kWh at launch (2014-2016); German Wikipedia table 24.2 gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: German Wikipedia: 21.2 kWh usable for the 2014-16 model (21.1 net per the registration table).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: German Wikipedia: 323 V nominal for the 2014 model.

chemistry.notes: ADAC manufacturer-data table for the 24.2 kWh e-Golf (03/14-10/16, European car): Nickel-Mangan-Cobalt. Same pack sold in the US 2015-2016; chemistry does not vary by market.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: DC power accepted at a maximum rate of 40 kW (CCS option, 2014-2016).

ac_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: the DC fast charging option also upgrades the onboard AC charger from 3.6 to 7.2 kW (2015-2016). Trims without DC have 3.6 kW (2015 US was SEL Premium only; the 2016 SE had no DC); the repo model notes also cite 6.6 kW from Autobytel/Cars.com.
